value.rationale: The formula completely resolves a natural two-rate least-squares stability benchmark, with no arbitrarily fixed rate ratio: it proves a unique norming time, strict ratio monotonicity and the exact universal sharp envelope 4. It separates high Gram coefficient conditioning from bounded projected-output amplification at both colliding and disparate rate limits; a sign-extremizer and rank-drop discontinuity make the threshold structurally interpretable.
